code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, upper, lower, trim

zones = zones.withColumn(
  "borough_clean", trim(upper(col("Borough")))
)
zones.select("Borough", "borough_clean").show(5)
caption: Whitespace and inconsistent casing break joins and groupBy later if left alone.

code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import concat, lit

zones = zones.withColumn(
  "zone_label", concat(col("Zone"), lit(", "), col("Borough"))
)
caption: lit() wraps a plain Python value so it can sit inside a column expression.

code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import substring

trips = trips.withColumn(
  "pickup_date_str",
  substring(col("tpep_pickup_datetime").cast("string"), 1, 10),
)
caption: Unlike Python string slicing — this trips up anyone coming from plain Python.
